question: Swarna runs at a speed of 10 km/h. How long will she take to cover 200 m?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Convert speed from **km/h** to **m/s** by multiplying with 5/18.

Speed = 10 × (5/18) = 25/9 **m/s**.

Time = Distance ÷ Speed = 200 ÷ (25/9) = 200 × 9 ÷ 25 = 8 × 9 = 72 **sec**.

**∴ The correct answer is 72 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of **Swarna** = 10 **km/h**

Distance to cover = 200 **m**

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Conversion: 1 **km/h** = 5/18 **m/s**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a36d4a052ebf358b97a2335f3296ebc2a02208f09301ee9fad082c6196641c4.png] 
**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed in **m/s** = 10 × (5/18) **m/s**

⇒ Speed = 50/18 = 25/9 **m/s**

⇒ Time = 200 ÷ (25/9)

⇒ Time = 200 × (9/25)

⇒ Time = 8 × 9

⇒ Time = 72 **sec**

**∴ The correct answer is 72 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert **km/h** to **m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert **m/s** to **km/h**, multiply by 18/5.

Speed-Distance Relationship

Distance = Speed × Time. When distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. For two equal distances with speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy/(x+y).</p
